# How to make a product launch video with Claude Code (HyperFrames, Remotion)

**Turn your app and a few lines of copy into a code-made launch, demo or explainer video: UI mockups, motion, charts, sound, no footage.**

**Price:** free on the main route, with no API key. Optional paid steps on the varg API: `video-sound` (~$0.01–0.02 per voice line, $0.01–0.06 per sound effect, $0.05 per 20 s music bed; mixing free).

<p><a href="../../app-ui-mockups/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_ecb6f84bf919.webp" alt="HTML-built UI mockups play in turn: a coding-agent terminal run, a team chat channel, a floating 3D code slab and a tilted analytics dashboard." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`app-ui-mockups`](../../app-ui-mockups/README.md): terminal sessions, chat threads, code editor walkthroughs and exploded UI rebuilt as HTML instead of screen recordings. The other 7 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-script --skill app-ui-mockups --skill kinetic-type-art --skill maps-and-data-motion --skill title-design --skill transition-craft --skill video-sound --skill media-judge
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a 30-second launch video for my CLI tool: a terminal demo, three feature beats and the install command at the end. Render it locally with HyperFrames."*

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `video-sound`: ~$0.01–0.02 per voice line, $0.01–0.06 per sound effect, $0.05 per 20 s music bed; mixing free.
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can Claude Code make a launch video?

Yes. The agent writes the video as HTML (HyperFrames) or React (Remotion) and renders an MP4 locally. These skills give it presets in numbers, so the result isn't a generic template.

### Do I need screen recordings of my app?

No. app-ui-mockups rebuilds ten UI types as HTML (phone message thread, team chat, coding-agent terminal, code editor, exploded UI panels), with typing at 12-20 characters a second and reading holds set from the character count.

### HyperFrames or Remotion?

Both work. The skills name HyperFrames blocks and Remotion equivalents; edit-footage-with-code suggests HyperFrames for HTML-first work the agent checks itself, and Remotion for React codebases, brand systems or data-driven batches.

### Can it show charts and numbers?

Yes. maps-and-data-motion has self-drawing bar and line charts, count-up statistics and versus timelines, with chart rules such as bars from zero and one accent series.

### Does it cost credits?

The motion templates render locally for free with OFL or Apache fonts. Only generated voice, music or footage uses varg credits, priced with estimate_cost first.
